mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index above 3.5% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to delay rate cuts and causing equity market sell-offs over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% annually over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls and RSAFS rises simultaneously over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts above 1300 thousand units signals robust residential construction, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1300.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annual growth rate above 2.0%), a decline in housing starts below 1350.0 thousand units signals cooling demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1350.0 and GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 102.0 (index 2017=100) signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 102.0 over a 3-year rolling window.
